description: A source-first, target-count-independent admission rubric. There is no desired pass count in this model.

gates.description: The referenced local PNG exists and decodes.
Preview is at least 480 x 300 pixels.
Libraries have an official repository and explicit license; editorial award references identify agency, award, year and source URL.
Canonical source link occurs exactly once.
Name, theme, vendor, tags and kind-specific metadata are non-empty.
Target is an HTTP(S) URL and the item exposes at least one classification or technology tag.
